options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: autoscaling
options.description: Autoscaler configuration for this NodePool. Autoscaler is enabled only if a valid configuration is present.

options.name: cluster
options.description: The cluster this node pool belongs to. This field represents a link to a Cluster resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'name' and value of your resource's name Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_container_cluster task and then set this cluster field to "{{ name-of-resource }}"

options.name: conditions
options.description: Which conditions caused the current node pool state.

options.name: config
options.description: The node configuration of the pool.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: initial_node_count
options.description: The initial node count for the pool. You must ensure that your Compute Engine resource quota is sufficient for this number of instances. You must also have available firewall and routes quota.

options.name: location
options.description: The location where the node pool is deployed.

options.name: max_pods_constraint
options.description: The constraint on the maximum number of pods that can be run simultaneously on a node in the node pool.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the node pool.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP

options.name: version
options.description: The version of the Kubernetes of this node.
